pages.title: Cosmic String Lens
pages.text: A loop of cosmic string that bends light into perfect focus. The missing wedge of space around the string acts as an ideal lens, with no aberration at all. It is a thin circle of light that hums faintly and never needs replacing.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)On the String Resonance Loom, I bent a Cosmic String Segment around a Tesseract Lens with a Graviton Crystal. The loop's conical space focused light more perfectly than any glass could.
Made in $(item)String Resonance Loom$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Multiverse.
